(* =========================================================================
   SECTION 3: THERMODYNAMIC ANTI-SUBLIMATION & FROST LAYER GROWTH MODEL
   ========================================================================= *)
(* Calculate partial pressure of CO2 in incoming flue gas [bar] *)
rCO2PartialPress_bar := (rFlueGasCO2_pct / 100.0) * rFlueGasInletPress_bar;

(* High-precision solid CO2 Clausius-Clapeyron sublimation pressure correlation *)
(* Valid range: 120 K <= T_wall <= 195 K. P_sat in [bar] *)
IF arrStateEst[2] < 216.58 THEN
    rCO2SublimationSatPress_bar := EXP(15.480 - (3120.0 / arrStateEst[2]));
ELSE
    rCO2SublimationSatPress_bar := c_CO2TriplePointPress_bar;
END_IF;

(* Driving force for solid desublimation delta P [bar] *)
IF rCO2PartialPress_bar > rCO2SublimationSatPress_bar THEN
    rSublimationDrivingForce_bar := rCO2PartialPress_bar - rCO2SublimationSatPress_bar;
ELSE
    rSublimationDrivingForce_bar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Convective mass transfer coefficient via Sherwood analogy [kg/(s*m2*bar)] *)
(* Sh = 0.023 * Re^0.8 * Sc^0.33, linearized around operating flue gas velocity *)
rMassTransferCoeff_kg_s_m2_bar := 0.00845 * (rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h / 5000.0) * SQRT(150.0 / arrStateEst[2]);

(* Theoretical frost deposition mass flux to refrigerated wall [kg/(s*m2)] *)
rFrostDepositionFlux_kg_s_m2 := rMassTransferCoeff_kg_s_m2_bar * rSublimationDrivingForce_bar;

(* Dynamic mechanical frost scraping mass removal flux [kg/(s*m2)] *)
(* Scraping commences when frost thickness exceeds physical blade gap c_ScraperBladeClearance_um *)
IF arrStateEst[1] > c_ScraperBladeClearance_um THEN
    rFrostScrapingFlux_kg_s_m2 := 0.88 * (arrStateEst[1] - c_ScraperBladeClearance_um) * 1.0E-6 *
                                  rFrostDensification_kgm3 * (rScraperShaftSpeed_rpm * 0.10472);
ELSE
    rFrostScrapingFlux_kg_s_m2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Porous frost layer bulk density dynamic evolution [kg/m3] *)
(* Internal vapor diffusion and scraper mechanical shearing cause densification *)
rFrostDensification_kgm3 := c_InitialFrostDensity_kgm3 +
    (c_PureSolidCO2Density_kgm3 - c_InitialFrostDensity_kgm3) *
    (1.0 - EXP(-0.00045 * (rScraperMotorTorque_Nm * rScraperShaftSpeed_rpm + 1.0) * arrStateEst[1]));

(* Frost layer effective thermal conductivity as quadratic function of density [W/(m*K)] *)
rFrostLayerConductivity_W_mK := 0.045 + (0.00035 * rFrostDensification_kgm3) + (1.2E-7 * rFrostDensification_kgm3 * rFrostDensification_kgm3);

(* Dynamic thermal resistance of frost deposit layer [m2*K/W] *)
rTotalThermalResistance_m2KW := (arrStateEst[1] * 1.0E-6) / rFrostLayerConductivity_W_mK;

(* Real-time solid CO2 mass recovery capture rate [kg/h] *)
rCO2CaptureRate_kg_h := (rFrostScrapingFlux_kg_s_m2 * c_ScraperEffectiveArea_m2) * 3600.0;

(* Flue gas CO2 separation efficiency calculation [%] *)
IF (rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h * rFlueGasCO2_pct) > 0.01 THEN
    rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := (rCO2CaptureRate_kg_h / ((rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h * (rFlueGasCO2_pct / 100.0)) * 1.964)) * 100.0;
    IF rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct > 99.8 THEN
        rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := 99.8;
    ELSIF rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct < 0.0 THEN
        rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

   SECTION 4: LIQUID METHANE SECONDARY REFRIGERANT CASCADE DYNAMICS
   ========================================================================= *)
(* Sensible cooling duty of flue gas [kW] *)
rSensibleHeatLoad_kW := (rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h * 1.25 * 1050.0 * (rVoted_FlueTemp_K - arrStateEst[3])) / 3.6E6;

(* Latent phase change heat release of desublimating CO2 [kW] *)
rLatentSublimationDuty_kW := (rCO2CaptureRate_kg_h * (c_LatentEnthalpySublim_J_kg / 1000.0)) / 3600.0;

(* Overall thermal refrigeration extraction duty [kW] *)
rRefrigerationDuty_kW := rSensibleHeatLoad_kW + rLatentSublimationDuty_kW;

(* Counter-current Logarithmic Mean Temperature Difference (LMTD) [K] *)
IF (rVoted_FlueTemp_K - arrStateEst[4]) > 1.0 AND (arrStateEst[3] - rMethaneSupplyTemp_K) > 1.0 THEN
    rLogMeanTempDiff_K := ((rVoted_FlueTemp_K - arrStateEst[4]) - (arrStateEst[3] - rMethaneSupplyTemp_K)) /
                          LN((rVoted_FlueTemp_K - arrStateEst[4]) / (arrStateEst[3] - rMethaneSupplyTemp_K));
ELSE
    rLogMeanTempDiff_K := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Cryogenic liquid methane equilibrium saturation vapor pressure [bar] *)
(* Antoine correlation for subcooled liquid methane: range 100 K to 135 K *)
IF rMethaneSupplyTemp_K > 90.0 AND rMethaneSupplyTemp_K < 150.0 THEN
    rMethaneVaporPress_bar := EXP(9.085 - (1055.2 / rMethaneSupplyTemp_K));
ELSE
    rMethaneVaporPress_bar := 1.013;
END_IF;

(* Subcooled liquid methane density at supply conditions [kg/m3] *)
rMethaneDensity_kgm3 := 422.6 - 0.75 * (rMethaneSupplyTemp_K - 111.6);

(* Pump Net Positive Suction Head Available (NPSHa) [m] *)
rMethanePumpNPSH_Available_m := ((rMethaneSuctionPress_bar - rMethaneVaporPress_bar) * 1.0E5) /
                                 (rMethaneDensity_kgm3 * c_GravitationalAccel_m_s2);

(* Pump manufacturer NPSH required with flow margin [m] *)
rMethanePumpNPSH_Required_m := 1.85 + 2.10 * (rMethaneMassFlow_kgh / 12000.0) * (rMethaneMassFlow_kgh / 12000.0);

(* Thermodynamic subcooling margin above saturation point [K] *)
rMethaneSubcoolingMargin_K := (1055.2 / (9.085 - LN(MAX(rMethaneSuctionPress_bar, 0.5)))) - rMethaneSupplyTemp_K;

(* =========================================================================
   SECTION 5: SCRAPER DYNAMIC UNBALANCE SPECTRAL ESTIMATION & COMPENSATION
   ========================================================================= *)
(* Convert shaft encoder angle from degrees to radians [0..2*pi] *)
rShaftAngleRadians := (rScraperEncoderAngle_deg * 3.14159265) / 180.0;

(* Real-time Synchronous Demodulation for 1X Rotational Harmonic Vibration *)
(* In-phase (I) and Quadrature (Q) projection of bearing radial vibration *)
rHarmonicInPhase_I := rVoted_ScraperVib_mms * COS(rShaftAngleRadians);
rHarmonicQuadrature_Q := rVoted_ScraperVib_mms * SIN(rShaftAngleRadians);

(* First-order digital exponential low-pass filter (tau = 0.25 s, alpha = 0.166) *)
rSpectralFilterAccum_I := rSpectralFilterAccum_I + 0.166 * (rHarmonicInPhase_I - rSpectralFilterAccum_I);
rSpectralFilterAccum_Q := rSpectralFilterAccum_Q + 0.166 * (rHarmonicQuadrature_Q - rSpectralFilterAccum_Q);

(* Extract 1X fundamental unbalance vector magnitude [mm/s] and angular phase [rad] *)
rUnbalanceVectorMag_mms := SQRT((rSpectralFilterAccum_I * rSpectralFilterAccum_I) +
                               (rSpectralFilterAccum_Q * rSpectralFilterAccum_Q)) * 2.0;

(* Real-time 4-quadrant arctangent phase angle extraction *)
IF ABS(rSpectralFilterAccum_I) > 0.001 THEN
    rUnbalanceVectorPhase_rad := ATAN(rSpectralFilterAccum_Q / rSpectralFilterAccum_I);
    IF rSpectralFilterAccum_I < 0.0 THEN
        rUnbalanceVectorPhase_rad := rUnbalanceVectorPhase_rad + 3.14159265;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF rSpectralFilterAccum_Q >= 0.0 THEN
        rUnbalanceVectorPhase_rad := 1.5707963;
    ELSE
        rUnbalanceVectorPhase_rad := -1.5707963;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic eccentric mass accumulation estimation [kg] *)
(* Derived from rotor mass, vibration velocity amplitude, and circular frequency omega *)
IF rScraperShaftSpeed_rpm > 5.0 THEN
    rEstimatedEccentricMass_kg := (rUnbalanceVectorMag_mms * 1.0E-3 * c_ScraperRotorInertia_kg_m2) /
                                  (c_ScraperRotorRadius_m * (rScraperShaftSpeed_rpm * 0.10472) * 0.125);
    IF rEstimatedEccentricMass_kg > 15.0 THEN
        rEstimatedEccentricMass_kg := 15.0; (* Physical saturation clamp *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rEstimatedEccentricMass_kg := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Centrifugal dynamic unbalance force vector magnitude [N] *)
rUnbalanceCentrifugalForce_N := rEstimatedEccentricMass_kg * c_ScraperRotorRadius_m *
                                ((rScraperShaftSpeed_rpm * 0.10472) * (rScraperShaftSpeed_rpm * 0.10472));

(* Dynamic counter-torque active compensation calculation [Nm] *)
(* Injected anti-phase torque waveform to cancel mechanical vibration torque ripple *)
rCounterTorquePhase_rad := rShaftAngleRadians - rUnbalanceVectorPhase_rad + 1.250; (* Lead phase advance *)
IF (iState = STATE_STEADY_STATE_CAPTURE) OR (iState = STATE_UNBALANCE_HARMONIC_COMP) THEN
    rScraperHarmonicCompTorque_Nm := -0.65 * (rUnbalanceCentrifugalForce_N * c_ScraperRotorRadius_m * 0.12) *
                                     COS(rCounterTorquePhase_rad);
    (* Clip compensation torque to drive inverter safe capability +/- 18 Nm *)
    IF rScraperHarmonicCompTorque_Nm > 18.0 THEN
        rScraperHarmonicCompTorque_Nm := 18.0;
    ELSIF rScraperHarmonicCompTorque_Nm < -18.0 THEN
        rScraperHarmonicCompTorque_Nm := -18.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rScraperHarmonicCompTorque_Nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* =========================================================================
   SECTION 6: DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE KALMAN OBSERVER EXECUTION
   ========================================================================= *)
(* 6.1 Assemble Current Measurement Vector y_meas *)
arrMeasuredOutputs[1] := (rTotalThermalResistance_m2KW * rFrostLayerConductivity_W_mK) * 1.0E6; (* Frost thickness [um] *)
arrMeasuredOutputs[2] := arrStateEst[2];          (* Reconstructed wall temperature [K] *)
arrMeasuredOutputs[3] := rVoted_FlueTemp_K - 18.5;(* Outlet flue gas temperature [K] *)
arrMeasuredOutputs[4] := rMethaneReturnTemp_K;   (* Liquid methane exit temperature [K] *)
arrMeasuredOutputs[5] := rUnbalanceVectorMag_mms;(* 1X unbalance vibration [mm/s] *)
arrMeasuredOutputs[6] := rScraperMotorTorque_Nm;  (* Actual motor torque load [Nm] *)

(* 6.2 Compute Innovation Residual Vector: e_y = y_meas - C_d * x_pred *)
arrResidualVector[1] := arrMeasuredOutputs[1] - arrStatePred[1];
arrResidualVector[2] := arrMeasuredOutputs[2] - arrStatePred[2];
arrResidualVector[3] := arrMeasuredOutputs[3] - arrStatePred[3];
arrResidualVector[4] := arrMeasuredOutputs[4] - arrStatePred[4];
arrResidualVector[5] := arrMeasuredOutputs[5] - arrStatePred[5];
arrResidualVector[6] := arrMeasuredOutputs[6] - arrStatePred[6];

(* 6.3 State Measurement Update: x_hat = x_pred + K_Kalman * e_y *)
arrStateEst[1] := arrStatePred[1] + (matK_Kalman[1, 1]*arrResidualVector[1] + matK_Kalman[1, 2]*arrResidualVector[2] + matK_Kalman[1, 3]*arrResidualVector[3] + matK_Kalman[1, 4]*arrResidualVector[4] + matK_Kalman[1, 5]*arrResidualVector[5] + matK_Kalman[1, 6]*arrResidualVector[6]);
arrStateEst[2] := arrStatePred[2] + (matK_Kalman[2, 1]*arrResidualVector[1] + matK_Kalman[2, 2]*arrResidualVector[2] + matK_Kalman[2, 3]*arrResidualVector[3] + matK_Kalman[2, 4]*arrResidualVector[4] + matK_Kalman[2, 5]*arrResidualVector[5] + matK_Kalman[2, 6]*arrResidualVector[6]);
arrStateEst[3] := arrStatePred[3] + (matK_Kalman[3, 1]*arrResidualVector[1] + matK_Kalman[3, 2]*arrResidualVector[2] + matK_Kalman[3, 3]*arrResidualVector[3] + matK_Kalman[3, 4]*arrResidualVector[4] + matK_Kalman[3, 5]*arrResidualVector[5] + matK_Kalman[3, 6]*arrResidualVector[6]);
arrStateEst[4] := arrStatePred[4] + (matK_Kalman[4, 1]*arrResidualVector[1] + matK_Kalman[4, 2]*arrResidualVector[2] + matK_Kalman[4, 3]*arrResidualVector[3] + matK_Kalman[4, 4]*arrResidualVector[4] + matK_Kalman[4, 5]*arrResidualVector[5] + matK_Kalman[4, 6]*arrResidualVector[6]);
arrStateEst[5] := arrStatePred[5] + (matK_Kalman[5, 1]*arrResidualVector[1] + matK_Kalman[5, 2]*arrResidualVector[2] + matK_Kalman[5, 3]*arrResidualVector[3] + matK_Kalman[5, 4]*arrResidualVector[4] + matK_Kalman[5, 5]*arrResidualVector[5] + matK_Kalman[5, 6]*arrResidualVector[6]);
arrStateEst[6] := arrStatePred[6] + (matK_Kalman[6, 1]*arrResidualVector[1] + matK_Kalman[6, 2]*arrResidualVector[2] + matK_Kalman[6, 3]*arrResidualVector[3] + matK_Kalman[6, 4]*arrResidualVector[4] + matK_Kalman[6, 5]*arrResidualVector[5] + matK_Kalman[6, 6]*arrResidualVector[6]);

(* 6.4 One-Step Ahead Time Update Predictor: x_pred = A_d * x_hat + B_d * u + E_d * d *)
arrControlInputs[1] := rScraperShaftSpeed_rpm;
arrControlInputs[2] := rMethaneFlowVlvPos_pct;
arrControlInputs[3] := rMethanePumpVFD_pct;

arrDisturbances[1] := rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h;
arrDisturbances[2] := rVoted_FlueTemp_K;
arrDisturbances[3] := rFlueGasCO2_pct;

arrStatePred[1] := (matA_d[1, 1]*arrStateEst[1] + matA_d[1, 2]*arrStateEst[2] + matA_d[1, 3]*arrStateEst[3] + matA_d[1, 4]*arrStateEst[4] + matA_d[1, 5]*arrStateEst[5] + matA_d[1, 6]*arrStateEst[6]) +
                   (matB_d[1, 1]*arrControlInputs[1] + matB_d[1, 2]*arrControlInputs[2] + matB_d[1, 3]*arrControlInputs[3]) +
                   (matE_d[1, 1]*arrDisturbances[1] + matE_d[1, 2]*arrDisturbances[2] + matE_d[1, 3]*arrDisturbances[3]);

arrStatePred[2] := (matA_d[2, 1]*arrStateEst[1] + matA_d[2, 2]*arrStateEst[2] + matA_d[2, 3]*arrStateEst[3] + matA_d[2, 4]*arrStateEst[4] + matA_d[2, 5]*arrStateEst[5] + matA_d[2, 6]*arrStateEst[6]) +
                   (matB_d[2, 1]*arrControlInputs[1] + matB_d[2, 2]*arrControlInputs[2] + matB_d[2, 3]*arrControlInputs[3]) +
                   (matE_d[2, 1]*arrDisturbances[1] + matE_d[2, 2]*arrDisturbances[2] + matE_d[2, 3]*arrDisturbances[3]);

arrStatePred[3] := (matA_d[3, 1]*arrStateEst[1] + matA_d[3, 2]*arrStateEst[2] + matA_d[3, 3]*arrStateEst[3] + matA_d[3, 4]*arrStateEst[4] + matA_d[3, 5]*arrStateEst[5] + matA_d[3, 6]*arrStateEst[6]) +
                   (matB_d[3, 1]*arrControlInputs[1] + matB_d[3, 2]*arrControlInputs[2] + matB_d[3, 3]*arrControlInputs[3]) +
                   (matE_d[3, 1]*arrDisturbances[1] + matE_d[3, 2]*arrDisturbances[2] + matE_d[3, 3]*arrDisturbances[3]);

arrStatePred[4] := (matA_d[4, 1]*arrStateEst[1] + matA_d[4, 2]*arrStateEst[2] + matA_d[4, 3]*arrStateEst[3] + matA_d[4, 4]*arrStateEst[4] + matA_d[4, 5]*arrStateEst[5] + matA_d[4, 6]*arrStateEst[6]) +
                   (matB_d[4, 1]*arrControlInputs[1] + matB_d[4, 2]*arrControlInputs[2] + matB_d[4, 3]*arrControlInputs[3]) +
                   (matE_d[4, 1]*arrDisturbances[1] + matE_d[4, 2]*arrDisturbances[2] + matE_d[4, 3]*arrDisturbances[3]);

arrStatePred[5] := (matA_d[5, 1]*arrStateEst[1] + matA_d[5, 2]*arrStateEst[2] + matA_d[5, 3]*arrStateEst[3] + matA_d[5, 4]*arrStateEst[4] + matA_d[5, 5]*arrStateEst[5] + matA_d[5, 6]*arrStateEst[6]) +
                   (matB_d[5, 1]*arrControlInputs[1] + matB_d[5, 2]*arrControlInputs[2] + matB_d[5, 3]*arrControlInputs[3]) +
                   (matE_d[5, 1]*arrDisturbances[1] + matE_d[5, 2]*arrDisturbances[2] + matE_d[5, 3]*arrDisturbances[3]);

arrStatePred[6] := (matA_d[6, 1]*arrStateEst[1] + matA_d[6, 2]*arrStateEst[2] + matA_d[6, 3]*arrStateEst[3] + matA_d[6, 4]*arrStateEst[4] + matA_d[6, 5]*arrStateEst[5] + matA_d[6, 6]*arrStateEst[6]) +
                   (matB_d[6, 1]*arrControlInputs[1] + matB_d[6, 2]*arrControlInputs[2] + matB_d[6, 3]*arrControlInputs[3]) +
                   (matE_d[6, 1]*arrDisturbances[1] + matE_d[6, 2]*arrDisturbances[2] + matE_d[6, 3]*arrDisturbances[3]);

rEstimatedFrostThickness_um := arrStateEst[1];

(* =========================================================================
   SECTION 7: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST APPROXIMATOR
   ========================================================================= *)
(* Compute Objective Tracking Error Gradient: g = Psi'*Q*(x_hat - r) *)
arrGradient[1] := (matB_d[1, 1] * arrWeightQ_diag[1] * (arrStateEst[1] - arrSetpointVector[1])) +
                  (matB_d[5, 1] * arrWeightQ_diag[5] * (arrStateEst[5] - arrSetpointVector[5])) +
                  (matB_d[6, 1] * arrWeightQ_diag[6] * (arrStateEst[6] - arrSetpointVector[6]));

arrGradient[2] := (matB_d[2, 2] * arrWeightQ_diag[2] * (arrStateEst[2] - arrSetpointVector[2])) +
                  (matB_d[3, 2] * arrWeightQ_diag[3] * (arrStateEst[3] - arrSetpointVector[3])) +
                  (matB_d[4, 2] * arrWeightQ_diag[4] * (arrStateEst[4] - arrSetpointVector[4]));

arrGradient[3] := (matB_d[2, 3] * arrWeightQ_diag[2] * (arrStateEst[2] - arrSetpointVector[2])) +
                  (matB_d[3, 3] * arrWeightQ_diag[3] * (arrStateEst[3] - arrSetpointVector[3])) +
                  (matB_d[4, 3] * arrWeightQ_diag[4] * (arrStateEst[4] - arrSetpointVector[4]));

(* Unconstrained Quadratic Minimization: delta_u* = - H_inv * g *)
arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := -(matHessianInv[1, 1]*arrGradient[1] + matHessianInv[1, 2]*arrGradient[2] + matHessianInv[1, 3]*arrGradient[3]);
arrDeltaU_Opt[2] := -(matHessianInv[2, 1]*arrGradient[1] + matHessianInv[2, 2]*arrGradient[2] + matHessianInv[2, 3]*arrGradient[3]);
arrDeltaU_Opt[3] := -(matHessianInv[3, 1]*arrGradient[1] + matHessianInv[3, 2]*arrGradient[2] + matHessianInv[3, 3]*arrGradient[3]);

(* Actuator Slew Rate Clipping per Scan Period dt = 0.050 s *)
IF arrDeltaU_Opt[1] > 2.5 THEN arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := 2.5; ELSIF arrDeltaU_Opt[1] < -2.5 THEN arrDeltaU_Opt[1] := -2.5; END_IF;
IF arrDeltaU_Opt[2] > 1.2 THEN arrDeltaU_Opt[2] := 1.2; ELSIF arrDeltaU_Opt[2] < -1.2 THEN arrDeltaU_Opt[2] := -1.2; END_IF;
IF arrDeltaU_Opt[3] > 1.5 THEN arrDeltaU_Opt[3] := 1.5; ELSIF arrDeltaU_Opt[3] < -1.5 THEN arrDeltaU_Opt[3] := -1.5; END_IF;

(* =========================================================================
   SECTION 8: ISA-18.2 MULTI-TIER ALARM MANAGEMENT & SAFETY INTERLOCK TREE
   ========================================================================= *)
(* Clear non-latched warning flags *)
dwAlarmWord2_Warning := 16#00000000;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Tier 1: Category 1 SIL-3 Critical Emergency Trips (Latching)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* E-Stop Trip *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1_Critical := dwAlarmWord1_Critical OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped *)
END_IF;

(* Scraper Vibration High-High Trip *)
IF rVoted_ScraperVib_mms >= c_Trip_ScraperVibrationHigh_mms THEN
    dwAlarmWord1_Critical := dwAlarmWord1_Critical OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Scraper Vib High-High Trip *)
END_IF;

(* ASHX Duct Differential Pressure High-High Trip *)
IF rVoted_DiffPress_mbar >= c_Trip_ASHX_DiffPressHigh_mbar THEN
    dwAlarmWord1_Critical := dwAlarmWord1_Critical OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Diff Press High-High Blockage *)
END_IF;

(* Liquid Methane Cavitation Suction Pressure Low-Low Trip *)
IF (rMethaneSuctionPress_bar <= c_Trip_MethaneSuctionLow_bar) AND (iState >= STATE_METHANE_CASCADE_CHILLDOWN) THEN
    dwAlarmWord1_Critical := dwAlarmWord1_Critical OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Methane Cavitation Low-Low *)
END_IF;

(* Scraper Motor Electromagnetic Torque Overload Trip *)
IF rScraperMotorTorque_Nm >= c_Trip_ScraperTorqueHigh_Nm THEN
    dwAlarmWord1_Critical := dwAlarmWord1_Critical OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Scraper Jam Torque High-High *)
END_IF;

(* Maximum Frost Layer Design Thickness Exceeded Trip *)
IF arrStateEst[1] >= c_MaxFrostThicknessDesign_um THEN
    dwAlarmWord1_Critical := dwAlarmWord1_Critical OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Frost Thickness Limit Exceeded *)
END_IF;

(* Scraper Cryogenic Bearing Overtemperature Trip *)
IF rScraperBearingTemp_K >= 335.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord1_Critical := dwAlarmWord1_Critical OR 16#00000400; (* Bit 10: Bearing Overheat *)
END_IF;

(* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Tier 2: Category 2 Process Operational Warnings (Auto-Resetting)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF rVoted_ScraperVib_mms >= c_Warn_ScraperVibrationHigh_mms THEN
    dwAlarmWord2_Warning := dwAlarmWord2_Warning OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Vibration High Warn *)
END_IF;

IF rVoted_DiffPress_mbar >= c_Warn_ASHX_DiffPressHigh_mbar THEN
    dwAlarmWord2_Warning := dwAlarmWord2_Warning OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Diff Press High Warn *)
END_IF;

IF rScraperMotorTorque_Nm >= c_Warn_ScraperTorqueHigh_Nm THEN
    dwAlarmWord2_Warning := dwAlarmWord2_Warning OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Scraper Torque High Warn *)
END_IF;

IF (rMethaneSubcoolingMargin_K <= c_Warn_MethaneSubcoolingLow_K) AND (iState >= STATE_SUBCOOLED_STANDBY) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2_Warning := dwAlarmWord2_Warning OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: Subcooling Margin Low Warn *)
END_IF;

IF (iTempVotingDegradation > 0) OR (iDiffPressVotingDegradation > 0) OR (iVibVotingDegradation > 0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2_Warning := dwAlarmWord2_Warning OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: TMR Channel Degraded Warn *)
END_IF;

IF rFlueGasMoisture_ppmv >= 1.50 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2_Warning := dwAlarmWord2_Warning OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Residual Moisture High Warn *)
END_IF;

IF rHXThermalResist_m2KW >= 0.038 THEN
    dwAlarmWord2_Warning := dwAlarmWord2_Warning OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Frost Thermal Resistance High *)
END_IF;

IF (rCO2CaptureEfficiency_pct < 85.0) AND (iState = STATE_STEADY_STATE_CAPTURE) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2_Warning := dwAlarmWord2_Warning OR 16#00000100; (* Bit 8: Separation Efficiency Low *)
END_IF;

(* Fault Reset Handling *)
IF bResetFault AND bEmergencyStop THEN
    dwAlarmWord1_Critical := 16#00000000;
    iAntiStallAttempts := 0;
END_IF;

(* Emergency Trip Transition Check *)
IF (dwAlarmWord1_Critical <> 16#00000000) AND (iState <> STATE_SIL_EMERGENCY_TRIP) THEN
    iState := STATE_SIL_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
END_IF;

(* =========================================================================
   SECTION 9: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE EXECUTION
   ========================================================================= *)
CASE iState OF
    STATE_BOOT_DIAGNOSTICS: (* State 0: System Initialization & Zero Checks *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE; (* Flue gas diverted during boot *)
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        bDefrostActive := FALSE;
        bScraperAntiStallActive := FALSE;
        bSystemHealthy := FALSE;
        rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := 0.0;
        rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := 0.0;
        rMethanePumpRamp_pct := 0.0;
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q AND bMasterEnable AND (dwAlarmWord1_Critical = 16#00000000) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := STATE_N2_INERT_PURGE;
        END_IF;

    STATE_N2_INERT_PURGE: (* State 10: Flue Gas Channel Dehydration & Inerting *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := 5.0; (* Low speed bearing lubrication rotation *)
        rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := 0.0;
        rMethanePumpRamp_pct := 0.0;
        tStateTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S);
        IF tStateTimer.Q AND (rFlueGasMoisture_ppmv < 1.0) THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := STATE_METHANE_CASCADE_CHILLDOWN;
        END_IF;

    STATE_METHANE_CASCADE_CHILLDOWN: (* State 20: Controlled Thermal Cooldown (< 1.5 K/min) *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := 8.0;
        (* Ramp cryogenic methane circulating pump and expansion valve *)
        IF rMethaneVlvRamp_pct < 35.0 THEN rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := rMethaneVlvRamp_pct + 0.15; END_IF;
        IF rMethanePumpRamp_pct < 45.0 THEN rMethanePumpRamp_pct := rMethanePumpRamp_pct + 0.20; END_IF;
        (* Check if secondary refrigerant has reached target cryogenic temperature 110 K *)
        IF (rMethaneReturnTemp_K <= 112.0) AND (rMethaneSupplyTemp_K <= 108.0) THEN
            iState := STATE_SUBCOOLED_STANDBY;
        END_IF;

    STATE_SUBCOOLED_STANDBY: (* State 30: Cryogenic Equilibrium Reached, Awaiting Gas Admission *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        bSystemHealthy := TRUE;
        rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := 10.0;
        rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := 30.0;
        rMethanePumpRamp_pct := 40.0;
        IF bMasterEnable AND (rFlueGasFlow_Nm3h > 500.0) THEN
            iState := STATE_FLUE_FEED_RAMP;
        END_IF;

    STATE_FLUE_FEED_RAMP: (* State 40: Admission of Flue Gas & Frost Nucleation Build *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE; (* Diverter begins closing, flue gas routed to ASHX *)
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := 25.0;
        (* Adapt refrigeration loop to thermal surge *)
        rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := 55.0;
        rMethanePumpRamp_pct := 65.0;
        (* Transition when frost layer forms stable nucleated bed >= 120 um *)
        IF arrStateEst[1] >= c_ScraperBladeClearance_um THEN
            iState := STATE_STEADY_STATE_CAPTURE;
        END_IF;

    STATE_STEADY_STATE_CAPTURE: (* State 50: Continuous Anti-Sublimation & Dynamic Scraping *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        bSystemHealthy := TRUE;

        rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm + arrDeltaU_Opt[1];
        rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := rMethaneVlvRamp_pct + arrDeltaU_Opt[2];
        rMethanePumpRamp_pct := rMethanePumpRamp_pct + arrDeltaU_Opt[3];
        (* Unbalance mitigation check *)
        IF rUnbalanceVectorMag_mms >= c_Warn_ScraperVibrationHigh_mms THEN
            iState := STATE_UNBALANCE_HARMONIC_COMP;
        ELSIF rScraperMotorTorque_Nm >= c_Warn_ScraperTorqueHigh_Nm THEN
            iState := STATE_SCRAPER_ANTI_STALL_JOG;
        ELSIF bDefrostManualTrigger THEN
            iState := STATE_THERMAL_DEFROST_FLUSH;
        END_IF;

    STATE_UNBALANCE_HARMONIC_COMP: (* State 60: Active Eccentric Mass Counter-Pulsing *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := FALSE;
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        (* Modulate speed to slip excitation away from shaft natural resonance *)
        IF rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm > 35.0 THEN
            rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm - 0.25;
        ELSE
            rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm + 0.25;
        END_IF;
        (* Methane cascade cooling adjustment *)
        rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := rMethaneVlvRamp_pct + arrDeltaU_Opt[2];
        rMethanePumpRamp_pct := rMethanePumpRamp_pct + arrDeltaU_Opt[3];
        (* Check if dynamic balancing has restored vibration to permissible zone *)
        IF rUnbalanceVectorMag_mms < (c_Warn_ScraperVibrationHigh_mms - 1.50) THEN
            iState := STATE_STEADY_STATE_CAPTURE;
        END_IF;

    STATE_SCRAPER_ANTI_STALL_JOG: (* State 70: Reverse-Forward Torque Pulse Unjamming Cycle *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE; (* Temporarily divert flue gas *)
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        bScraperAntiStallActive := TRUE;
        tAntiStallTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);
        IF NOT tAntiStallTimer.Q THEN
            (* Reverse scraper jog at low speed to crack compacted dry ice bridge *)
            rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := -12.0;
        ELSE
            tAntiStallTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iAntiStallAttempts := iAntiStallAttempts + 1;
            bScraperAntiStallActive := FALSE;
            IF (rScraperMotorTorque_Nm < c_Warn_ScraperTorqueHigh_Nm) THEN
                iState := STATE_STEADY_STATE_CAPTURE;
            ELSIF iAntiStallAttempts >= 3 THEN
                dwAlarmWord1_Critical := dwAlarmWord1_Critical OR 16#00000010; (* Unresolvable Jam *)
                iState := STATE_SIL_EMERGENCY_TRIP;
            ELSE
                rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := 30.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    STATE_THERMAL_DEFROST_FLUSH: (* State 80: High-Enthalpy Sublimation Regeneration Flush *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        bDefrostActive := TRUE;
        rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := 45.0; (* High speed scraper sweeping *)
        (* Throttle liquid methane cooling to allow controlled wall warming to 198 K *)
        rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := 10.0;
        rMethanePumpRamp_pct := 20.0;
        tDefrostTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);
        IF tDefrostTimer.Q OR (arrStateEst[1] < 20.0) THEN
            tDefrostTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bDefrostActive := FALSE;
            iState := STATE_METHANE_CASCADE_CHILLDOWN;
        END_IF;

    STATE_CONTROLLED_RAMP_DOWN: (* State 90: Orderly Plant Shutdown & Warm-Up Sweep *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := FALSE;
        bSystemHealthy := FALSE;
        IF rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm > 0.5 THEN rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm - 0.50; END_IF;
        IF rMethaneVlvRamp_pct > 0.5 THEN rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := rMethaneVlvRamp_pct - 0.50; END_IF;
        IF rMethanePumpRamp_pct > 0.5 THEN rMethanePumpRamp_pct := rMethanePumpRamp_pct - 0.50; END_IF;
        IF (rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm <= 0.5) AND (rMethanePumpRamp_pct <= 0.5) THEN
            iState := STATE_BOOT_DIAGNOSTICS;
        END_IF;

    STATE_SIL_EMERGENCY_TRIP: (* State 99: Fail-Safe Emergency Trip Lock-Out *)
        bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;   (* Immediate divert to stack / thermal oxidizer *)
        bLiquidMethaneIso_Trip := TRUE; (* Close cryogenic block valves < 1.2 s *)
        bSystemHealthy := FALSE;
        bDefrostActive := FALSE;
        bScraperAntiStallActive := FALSE;
        rScraperSpeedRamp_rpm := 0.0;   (* Immediate mechanical brake actuation *)
        rScraperHarmonicCompTorque_Nm := 0.0;
        rMethaneVlvRamp_pct := 0.0;     (* Spring-return close *)
        rMethanePumpVFD_pct := 0.0;     (* Instantaneous VFD trip *)
        IF bResetFault AND (dwAlarmWord1_Critical = 16#00000000) THEN
            iState := STATE_BOOT_DIAGNOSTICS;
        END_IF;

END_CASE;
